# Prepare release 0.1.1

Status: Completed

Prepare the version, release evidence and candidate checks. Diagnose slow local verification. Native package and upgrade acceptance is not a release gate.

## Scope

- In: Version 0.1.1, appearance source checks, local verification timing, release readiness.
- Out: Publishing a release, pushing tags, changing host security settings.

## Tasks

- [x] T1 — Diagnose verification time (Completed)
  Acceptance: Record measured build, test and repeated-run timing. Separate evidence from suspected causes.
- [x] T2 — Prepare version and appearance sources (Completed)
  Acceptance: The 0.1.1 version gate passes. Check theme sources and record remaining visual acceptance.
- [x] T3 — Verify the candidate (Completed)
  Acceptance: just check and relevant generated documentation checks pass.
- [ ] T4 — Accept native packages and upgrades (Cancelled)
  Acceptance: Record downloaded package acceptance on all three platforms and the 0.1.0 upgrade result before release.

## Validation

- Verification timing has measured evidence.
  Result: Previous full check passed: build 34.34 seconds, Clippy 1.53 seconds; map GPU tests 54.67 seconds, schematic GPU tests 47.24 seconds, UI tests 45.24 seconds. Repeated core doc-test command: real 51.42 seconds, user 0.99 seconds, system 2.26 seconds, zero doc tests. A repeated xtask version unit test took 0.01 seconds. Most doc-test wall time is outside CPU execution. The local APFS volume is 96 percent used, and a directory-stat process entered uninterruptible wait. Storage contention is suspected; security-scanning logs did not establish a cause. Do not weaken checks or disable host security on this evidence.
- Version gate and candidate checks pass.
  Result: Version gate reports version=0.1.1 and prerelease=false. Project Maintainer reported on 2026-10-10 that just check and just docs pass on the candidate, and that appearance visual acceptance passed.
- Native packages and upgrades receive acceptance.
  Result: Not required before release (decision packages-not-gate). The macOS upgrade from 0.1.0 remains open as auto-update T6.

## Decision candidate-version

Set the workspace and locked local packages to 0.1.1.

Why: The candidate must pass the same version gate used by the release workflow.

Consequences: Version gate now reports version=0.1.1 and prerelease=false. This does not publish a tag or prove native package acceptance.

## Decision packages-not-gate

Native package and upgrade acceptance is not a hard gate for 0.1.1.

Why: Project Maintainer decision on 2026-10-10. The real upgrade path can only be exercised after a newer release exists.

Consequences: T4 is cancelled. Package problems found after release are fixed in a later patch release; auto-update T6 keeps the macOS upgrade check open.
